items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury; earlier optimism from sources that he would play absent setbacks.
items.why: Official active list; Schefter and Rapoport confirmation after ETR GTD/optimism
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; high fantasy ranking lock
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in favorable matchup; no reverse of prior beneficiaries

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall INACTIVE for Week 7; earlier ETR GTD/pessimism.
items.why: Official inactives list after quad issue and limited practice
items.implication: Jets backfield opens fully to handcuffs/backups
items.opportunity: Snap/carry/target share to remaining Jets RBs

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals with high-ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley to start again.
items.why: ETR weekend summary and Schefter report of high-ankle sprain
items.implication: Ravens pass game downgrade; Huntley streaming considerations limited
items.opportunity: Increased work for Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely and Ravens RBs in favorable matchup

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) OUT for Monday Night vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Major pass-catching vacuum; AJ Brown or others elevated if active
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Eagles pass catchers including Goedert; possible RB involvement

items.text: Thinks Cam Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; ETR watching with Tracy also hamstring. Rapoport noted lead back expected.
items.why: Levitan player-specific read; Berry pre-hate on matchup
items.implication: Potential limited role or risk; monitor for next
items.opportunity: If limited, Tracy or others gain; reverse if full
items.conflict: Rapoport lead expected vs Levitan hurt lean

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after turning ankle on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if serious while correctly not scoring.
items.why: Levitan assessment post-ETR watch list; purposeful slide context
items.implication: No downgrade; maintain elite RB ranking/usage

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs Cowboys after hamstring; Berry also noted in line to play with efficient prior games and great matchup.
items.why: ETR weekend reports; matchup vs soft Dallas run D
items.implication: RB1/2 start if active; volume expected

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and returning for Packers; Berry hated post-layoff workload uncertainty.
items.why: ETR IN list and Rapoport confirmation of return
items.implication: Lead back role likely but rusty; Berry fade for Week 7
items.opportunity: Carries but potential committee or limited snaps initially
items.conflict: Berry HATE due to layoff vs ETR/Schefter activation

items.text: Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues after Broncos activation from IR; will be the Broncos RB you wish you had.
items.why: Prior production before injury; Dobbins/Harvey inefficiency; ETR IN
items.implication: Handcuff/upside stash with path to work

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI for usage/matchup (WR10); Bears soft for yardage.
items.why: Usage return and favorable Bears matchup
items.implication: Strong WR start; elevated further with Smith/Wicks OUT
items.opportunity: Targets/routes in good spot; possible beneficiary of teammate absences

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6) as Lions D is fantasy buffet for opposing pass catchers.
items.why: Matchup vs soft Lions pass D

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Workloads vs defenses carved by RBs; consistency for Hubbard

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (shadow), Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low scoring), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D).
Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET post-layoff workload questions and Cam Skattebo @ HOU brutal spot.
items.why: Layoff for Jacobs; tough matchup for Skattebo
items.conflict: Jacobs activation vs hate; Skattebo lead vs hurt lean
